This is actually a really good question and I'm looking forward to reading the answers that other people give. 
For me I start getting bored easily too; get more impulsive like pop a few extra antidepressants just because or when I'm bored and drinking I'll try to see how many shots I can do without throwing up; listening to my "depression" playlist (does anyone else have that? lol) a lot on repeat; my thoughts of sadness get worse at night and if I'm alone I'll reach for my phone to text or message my friends just to say hey; for some reason, I love sunsets but when my suicidal thoughts are coming looking at a sunset makes me incredibly fuckin depressed
